title: Parking-Notice Surcharge, Community Rules & Site Care Enforcement Schedule
content:
A parking-notice surcharge is added to the monthly vehicle permit fee of a Community Rules & Site Care plan record for every permit charged. Its rate turns on the violation notices in the vehicles and parking class that the plan record carries, served within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date:

| Vehicles and parking notices served within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date | Surcharge for every permit charged |
|---|---|
| two or more | $10.00 per permit |
| exactly one | $5.00 per permit |
| none | nothing |

The surcharge is the per-permit figure multiplied by the number of permits charged for the month, so a month with no permit carries no surcharge.

## The threshold on both sides

- One vehicles and parking notice in the 12 months: $5.00 per permit. A second such notice in the same 12 months: $10.00 per permit.
- Notices in other rule classes, and vehicles and parking notices served before the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date, do not enter the count.

## Hypothetical cases

| Permits charged for the month | Vehicles and parking notices in the 12 months | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 3 | $20.00 |
| 1 | 2 | $10.00 |
| 3 | 1 | $15.00 |
| 2 | 0 | nothing |
